full_core_grid: 100 rounded log-spaced integers from 3 to 10000, union all S <=10000
head_output: Every N=3..10^7 computed; compressed CSV preserves all b_N and head values. Summary and crossings plain CSV.
J1: All-input analytical domination plus rigorous enclosures; old e_N decimal estimates remain labeled diagnostic.
J2: For N=10,20,50, inequality (11) applies to optimal true-Gram coefficients; ehat-e <= U(c_opt)-E(c_opt) <= RHS(11). Report both gap and RHS.
J3: Independent direct residue finite sum through K-1 vs head+floor-block shoulder, absolute error <=1e-10 at N=3..200. Full norm minus exact tail is identity; 5/log² is a bound and must not be subtracted as equality.
J4: Literal psi replacement with unchanged s_N; derive planted prefix before run; no additive offset. Leading power 2 Re(rho)-1=2/3, with log^-2 and oscillatory modulation. Compare finite-grid slope to analytic plant-only discrete prefix, tolerance 0.05; also report raw and log-corrected slopes.

P1.rule: ehat/e <=1.5 at every certificate grid N<=1000

P2.rule: ehat*log(N)<=1/2 certified at all certificate grid points

P3.rule: at least 10 crossings in [3,10^4] and nonempty in each decade [3,10),[10,100),...,[10^6,10^7]

P4.rule: max full H over S intersect [1000,10000] <=1; empty set is not HIT

P5.rule: finite-range operational score: all head*log(N) on S with N>=10000 lie in [0.02,0.3]; additionally report fits and range, never infer asymptotic equivalence

P6.rule: J4 passes analytically derived finite-window slope gate

honesty: Finite experiment only; CHALLENGER_NOT_RH; PX_RH_CLAIM NOT_MADE. Each failed judge voids only its guarded part.
